subject: Any game that makes Kev...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Swear like a trooper, like he has woke up next to Jar Jar Binks, from a bender of a night, and found out that young whipper snapper, Luke, has shot his load into a 2 meters square hole, that he was supposed to fix, the night before, Double D'oh!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Rainbow 6 Vegas
author: kevlar0
body:
We have had some legendary nights on Rainbow, I mean, 14 of your friends in the same room, pretty much all of em elites apart from the odd bit of cannon fodder coughzomcough (only kidding tammify), you can only imagine the crack we have, and if your team loses you WILL be taunted and abused for your poor show and if you win, you are the best in the world, and you make sure the losers know that too.

Clan matches are a good buzz also, i can remember beating some good clans as the JAM/FAQ clan, but what i remember most about the clan matches are the arguments, we have had some monumentous fall outs with various clans, accusations of glitching, spawn camping and general poor sportsmanship, but we have a secret weapon that goes by the name of CYBER ANI, DONT mess with this girl, she will hand your saa to you on a silver plate either verbally or in the game. anyhow lots of good memories and wouldn't change a thing, and lots more nights like that i hope..

my dog ate my disc.
